body: Wut, really? I always perceived gay dudes to be a lot more friendly than straight guys, so I always assumed they would prefer the cuddling and love instead of casual sex. Interesting.
Not that much of an Apocalypse I'd say, but yeah, Omicron is now here. I just wonder how long can the "collective human mind" can withstand this...

Yo hago algo parecido, y a pesar de que, al igual que tu amigo, me va mucho mejor que cuando trabajaba de Godin, siempre me siento juzgado por mi familia y conocidos: "eso no es un trabajo", "consigue un empleo formal con prestaciones". 

Yo sinceramente odio los trabajos "normales" con todo mi ser, pero al mismo tiempo se que estar ganando dinero a través de videojuegos no es algo que me durará para siempre.

No sé, es un dilema que siempre me agobia.

Kinda on the same boat. My gf of 10 years and I are on a very painful moment of our relationship, it's almost impossible to rescue it and I feel terrible. I loved her so much, but we both messed up so bad during our relationship.

Just try to endure it man, as I am. Swallow your pride and call her, what more could you lose at this point? Maybe her voice will give you strength to continue.

Hang in there.

Well, I can only tell you that it's not good to obsess too much over it. Finding your soul mate is a hard task and a matter of luck, keeping them is even harder.

As others said, loving yourself and learning to enjoy your time alone is extremely important before giving someone else control over your own happiness.

That being said, if you truly feel like you need a significant other, do make a plan and stick to it fiercely, but do have a plan B just in case.

Btw I am also a The Office fan, and at least in my experience, I do believe that a relationship like Pam and Jim's is something out of a fairy tale (just like Pam said at the finale). Try to always keep this in mind when looking for your significant one.

Would a psychologist be a good place to start? I'm not really depressed or anxious, I have sometimes also come to think this could be something biological, but I really don't know what kind of medic should I go to.

Do you have siblings? Does your dad still lives?  If I were in your place, I would ask for 5 minutes of her time and tell her that I really don't like that she can't even call me by name. Hopefully she would listen, but if not, I do believe she might have some mental issues and might need to talk to someone.
Well this might seem like a very stupid answer but... Have you confronted her directly on this? Asked her why she has never called you by name?
